facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of P-3220 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3220, M-3220 and PT-3220 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-3220, M-3220 and PT-3220 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-3220 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 6 March 2010 an incident occurred on P-3220, M-3220 and PT-3220 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
